Core: Typography

Source: vignettes/core-typography.Rmd
core-typography.Rmd
library(shiny)
library(shiny.mantine)

An R rewrite of the “Typography” category on mantine.dev/core. Table() is covered in vignette("core-data-display") instead, matching mantine.dev’s own categorization of it as data display.

Text

https://mantine.dev/core/text/ — the base text component; every size/color/weight prop (size, c for color, fw, ta, truncate, …) works exactly as documented on mantine.dev.

Text("Regular paragraph text.")
Text("Dimmed, smaller helper text.", size = "sm", c = "dimmed")
Text("Bold, colored text.", fw = 700, c = "blue")

Text() also supports a gradient variant:

Text("Gradient heading", variant = "gradient", gradient = list(from = "blue", to = "cyan"), fw = 900, size = "xl")

Title

https://mantine.dev/core/title/ — semantic headings (order 1-6, mapping to <h1>-<h6>).

Stack(Title("Heading 1", order = 1), Title("Heading 2", order = 2), Title("Heading 3", order = 3))

Blockquote

https://mantine.dev/core/blockquote/ — a styled quotation block, with an optional cite and icon.

Blockquote(cite = "– Ada Lovelace", icon = IconFingerprint(size = 20), "The Analytical Engine has no pretensions whatever to originate anything.")

Code

https://mantine.dev/core/code/ — inline or block code-styled text (for real syntax-highlighted code blocks, see CodeHighlight() in vignette("satellite-packages") instead).

Text("Run ", Code("install.packages(\"shiny\")"), " to get started.")
Code(block = TRUE, "shiny::runApp(\"app.R\")")

Highlight

https://mantine.dev/core/highlight/ — renders text with one or more substrings visually highlighted.

Highlight(highlight = c("Mantine", "Shiny"), "shiny.mantine brings Mantine UI to Shiny apps.")

List

https://mantine.dev/core/list/ — a bulleted or numbered list; ListItem()s nest inside.

List(type = "ordered", ListItem("First step"), ListItem("Second step"), ListItem("Third step"))

Mark

https://mantine.dev/core/mark/ — highlighted text using the native <mark> element (a simpler, single-purpose alternative to Highlight() when you already know exactly which text node to mark).

Text("This is ", Mark("marked"), " text.")

Typography

https://mantine.dev/core/typography/ — applies Mantine’s prose styling (headings, links, lists, code blocks, …) to arbitrary raw HTML content, e.g. Markdown rendered server-side.

Typography(HTML(markdown::markdownToHTML(text = "# Title\n\nSome **bold** text and a [link](https://mantine.dev).", fragment.only = TRUE)))

Where to go next
